ideas.pitch: A localized environmental compliance and wildfire smoke risk forecasting tool for Los Angeles county businesses, combining satellite data and Poisson regression.
ideas.title: CaliCast
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the pattern of AI incident forecasting and environmental monitoring, addressing a major local concern in Southern California with concrete predictive modeling.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered mobility platform that groups elderly and mobility-impaired residents in Los Angeles with verified volunteer drivers for essential healthcare trips.
ideas.title: LA-Transit-Match
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of clear measurable social impact and targets a demographic and transit pain point familiar to anyone living in Los Angeles.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk-detection and graph-intelligence platform designed to vet independent production investments and contractor chains for Los Angeles entertainment startups.
ideas.title: StudioShield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies graph intelligence and risk detection to a dominant regional industry, matching the technical depth of specialized AML and compliance winners.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous no-code strategy builder and execution platform for decentralized perpetual markets, tailored for student and amateur traders in California.
ideas.title: PacificProp AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the grand prize-winning formula of building a complete, high-utility financial tool that allows users to seamlessly copy and execute complex strategies.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and meal recommendation platform optimized for local Los Angeles grocery availability, budget constraints, and specialized dietary needs.
ideas.title: NutriLA
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses personal health metrics and localized data curation to solve daily consumer friction, mirroring successful 24-hour hackathon wellness apps.
